description: This file defines the AutoEscapeTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing autoescape tags in templates.

classes.name: AutoEscapeTokenParser
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing 'autoescape' tags in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the autoescape token to create an AutoEscapeNode, determining the escape strategy and body.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token marks the end of the autoescape block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name this parser handles, which is 'autoescape'.
